clue.text: Standard note retained by the Civil Service unchanged

indicators.note: something retained by another is held inside it, so the note goes within the civil service letters

parts.note: CS is the standard abbreviation for the Civil Service
la is the sixth note of the sol-fa scale
sic is the Latin tag printed to show a quotation is left as it was

explanation.surface: A civil servant's memo, filed away untouched, sets the official standard.
explanation.definitionFit: A classic is a work held up as a model of its kind, a benchmark of excellence.

clue.text: Drinking-place for show offs?

parts.note: to crow is to boast, so a pub for boasters would be a bar for crowing, read as a heavy lever

explanation.surface: A pub where the braggarts gather.
explanation.definitionFit: A crowbar is an iron lever with a flattened end, used for prising things open.

clue.text: A very quiet area of London that's most attractive

parts.note: pp, pianissimo, is the musical marking for very quietly
Ealing is a district of west London, known for its film studios

explanation.surface: A peaceful part of London is the pick of the city.
explanation.walkthrough: EALING is a borough in west London.
explanation.definitionFit: Appealing means attractive or charming; the clue's superlative is loose, as the word means simply pleasing.

clue.text: Argue a point before the summit

parts.note: S, south, is one of the compass points
a peak is a mountain summit

explanation.surface: Someone makes their case before reaching the top of the mountain.
explanation.walkthrough: 'before' simply puts the compass point ahead of the summit.
explanation.definitionFit: To speak can mean to argue or plead a case, as in speaking for a motion.

clue.text: Many an ordinary seaman, an experienced sailor, will play a leading role

parts.note: C, the Roman numeral for a hundred, stands for many
OS is the naval abbreviation for an ordinary seaman
a tar, or old tar, is a seasoned sailor

explanation.surface: A ship's crew where everyone gets top billing.
explanation.definitionFit: To costar is to share top billing with another lead actor.

clue.text: Beam if Matron's about!

indicators.note: about here means moved around, so the letters of the clue word are scrambled into a new order

explanation.surface: A warning to look busy when the formidable hospital matron is on her rounds.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' rearranges MATRONS; 'if' is only a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A transom is a horizontal crossbar or beam, as over a door or window.

clue.text: When given to some flowering plants they turn brown

parts.note: asters are daisy-like flowering garden plants

explanation.surface: Flowers given too much sun wither and go brown.
explanation.walkthrough: 'When given' is a link; 'they turn brown' describes the bread, not the flowers.
explanation.definitionFit: Toasters are kitchen appliances that brown slices of bread.

clue.text: Hate a man to be fluttering around one

indicators.note: around means the scrambled letters surround the single letter
fluttering suggests the letters flapping about and landing in a new order

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A nervous fellow is to hover around someone he loathes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fluttering' rearranges A MAN TO BE; 'around' puts those letters round I.
explanation.definitionFit: To abominate is to loathe or detest something intensely.

clue.text: Smart road in the German capital

parts.note: St, street, is a road

indicators.note: a capital is a capital letter, so the first letter of the word is taken

explanation.surface: A stylish avenue in the centre of Berlin.
explanation.walkthrough: 'capital' looks like a city; it means the first letter. 'the' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A sting is a sharp smarting pain, and to smart is to sting.

clue.text: The artist's dull-without craft, that is

parts.note: matt or mat describes a dull, unglossy finish

indicators.note: without in its old sense means outside, so the 'that is' letters surround the craft

parts.note: ie, id est, means that is
SS, steamship, is a craft

explanation.surface: An artist dismissed as dull and lacking skill.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' looks like 'lacking' but is the old sense of outside. Henri Matisse was a French painter.
explanation.definitionFit: Henri Matisse was a French painter, a leader of the Fauvist movement.

clue.text: Work iron, but treat wrongly

parts.note: op, short for opus, is a musical or literary work
to press clothes is to iron them

explanation.surface: Doing the ironing badly, as though mistreating the laundry.
explanation.definitionFit: To oppress is to keep people down by harsh, unjust treatment.

clue.text: The man who loves setting a medico right first

parts.note: MO, medical officer, is an army doctor
1st, written IST in crosswords, stands for first

explanation.surface: Someone sets a doctor right first, perhaps a lover with strong opinions.
explanation.walkthrough: 'setting' is a link here; the pieces simply run in order, with '1st' read as the letters I, S, T.
explanation.definitionFit: An amorist is a lover, someone devoted to romance and courtship.

clue.text: They're explosive haven't got what it takes to make a hit

definitions.text: They're explosive haven't got what it takes to make a hit

parts.words: They're explosive haven't got what it takes to make a hit
parts.note: rounds that go bang yet carry no bullet, so they can never strike a target, read as people lacking the talent to succeed

explanation.surface: Some flashy performers are all noise and no talent.
explanation.definitionFit: These are gun cartridges filled with powder but no shot, used for noise or training.

clue.text: The painter is into fruit

parts.note: RA is a Royal Academician, a painter elected to the Royal Academy
into here supplies the short word in

explanation.surface: An artist confesses a passion for fruit, perhaps for still lifes.
explanation.definitionFit: A raisin is a dried grape, a kind of dried fruit.

clue.text: Get in (order) make — up etc, mind

parts.note: to tell someone to do something is to order them

indicators.note: make up here means compose afresh, so the letters of the short abbreviation are rearranged

explanation.surface: Instructions for assembling something, with the rest left vague.
explanation.walkthrough: 'make — up' rearranges ETC to give ECT; 'Get' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: The intellect is the mind's power to reason and understand.

clue.text: Establish no gear is necessary

indicators.note: taken as a hint that the letters must be put in the needed order, signalling an anagram of the three words

explanation.surface: Advice that a trip or business can be set up without any equipment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'necessary' is a loose anagram signal: the letters of NO GEAR IS must be arranged as required.
explanation.definitionFit: To organise something is to set it up and arrange it, as in establishing a club.

clue.text: Schedule-in time trains will follow it!

definitions.meaning: a planned list of places and times on a journey

definitions.text: in time trains will follow it!
definitions.meaning: a railway timetable route that punctual trains keep to

explanation.definitionFit: An itinerary is a planned route or schedule for a journey.

clue.text: Broke, yet ran to a legal adviser

indicators.note: broke means smashed into pieces, so the letters of the three words are reassembled

explanation.surface: Though penniless, someone still went to a lawyer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Broke' looks like 'penniless' but rearranges YET RAN TO.
explanation.definitionFit: An attorney is a lawyer, especially in the United States.

clue.text: Some girls in love get a tender look and grow passive

indicators.note: the answer sits in the run of letters across these words, read straight through

explanation.surface: Lovestruck girls go dreamy-eyed and become listless.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters run across 'loVE GET A TEnder'; 'Some girls' and 'look and' are surface padding.
explanation.definitionFit: To vegetate is to lead a dull, inactive life with no effort or interest.

clue.text: The music man's shaky

parts.note: a player or singer whose notes waver deliberately for expressive effect

explanation.surface: A nervous musician trembles on stage.
explanation.definitionFit: Vibrato is a regular pulsating variation in pitch, giving a tremulous sound.

clue.text: An agency not favoured by extremists

definitions.meaning: a means or agency through which something is done
the happy ..., the middle course, is what extremists reject

explanation.definitionFit: A medium is a channel through which something acts, and also the middle way between extremes.

clue.text: Land in absurd situation when set wrong

indicators.note: in means the land word is placed inside the absurd word

parts.note: mad means absurd or crazy
an isle is a piece of land surrounded by water

explanation.surface: Someone is landed in a ridiculous predicament after being given wrong directions.
explanation.definitionFit: To mislead is to send someone the wrong way or give a false impression.

clue.text: Fearful outcome of a feminine assault

parts.note: F is the grammatical abbreviation for feminine
a raid is a sudden attack or assault

explanation.surface: A woman's attack leaves everyone frightened.
explanation.definitionFit: Afraid means scared or anxious.

clue.text: A blooming fight follows after a bet is made!

definitions.text: A blooming fight follows after a bet is made!

parts.words: A blooming fight follows after a bet is made!
parts.note: blooming suggests a mild oath for a nasty quarrel over a wager, but literally means made of flowers, as in a carnival parade

explanation.surface: A row breaks out after someone places a wager.
explanation.walkthrough: 'blooming' looks like a mild British swear word; it really means a fight fought with blossoms. This is a carnival custom in which floats and people pelt each other with flowers.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a festival, as in Jersey or Nice, where people throw flowers at one another in mock combat.

clue.text: A charge-an article's to be written about it

indicators.note: written about means the article is written around the other word, enclosing it

parts.note: the is the definite article

explanation.surface: A journalist's fee for writing an article.
explanation.definitionFit: A tithe was a tax of a tenth of produce paid to support the church.

clue.text: Lie or go to the dogs in college

indicators.note: to go to the dogs is to fall to ruin, so the letters fall apart and rearrange

explanation.surface: A student lies or ruins himself while at university.
explanation.walkthrough: ORIEL is a college of Oxford University.
explanation.definitionFit: Oriel is one of the colleges of Oxford University.

clue.text: Play years on end as a hunter becoming the hunted

parts.note: to act is to play a part
an aeon is an immensely long stretch of years

explanation.surface: An actor plays for years in the role of a huntsman turned quarry.
explanation.walkthrough: In Greek myth Actaeon saw Artemis bathing; she turned him into a stag and his own hounds hunted him down.
explanation.definitionFit: The mythical huntsman was changed into a stag and torn apart by his own hounds, the hunter turned prey.

clue.text: A private picture — gallery causing disquiet

parts.note: a GI is an American private soldier
the Tate is a famous London picture gallery

explanation.surface: A soldier's visit to an art gallery stirs up trouble.
explanation.definitionFit: To agitate is to disturb or unsettle, stirring up anxiety.

clue.text: Plainly there's nothing green left by the end of July

parts.note: O, the round figure zero, means nothing
vert is the heraldic term for green

indicators.note: the end of a word is its final letter, here taken from the month

explanation.surface: Clearly the garden has dried out by the close of midsummer.
explanation.definitionFit: Overtly means openly and without concealment, in plain view.

clue.text: Action about deposit should be postponed

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the action word goes round the deposit word

parts.note: a deed is an act or action
to lay something is to deposit it, as a hen lays an egg

explanation.surface: A bank transaction involving a deposit is held up.
explanation.definitionFit: Delayed means put off until later, which is what being postponed means.
